To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
plant science can contribute novel insight and research tools for understanding how plant-based foods promote human health.
plant science research can contribute to human health by providing novel insight into which metabolite in which plant-based food reduces the risk of chronic diseases and how these metabolites work.

(i) plant biochemistry, plant genetics, and metabolic engineering can contribute significantly to human health through identification and measurement of plant metabolites that promote health (phytochemicals) and through the development of research tools that provide insight into how phytochemicals work; (ii) the use of plant research tools to study human nutrition is a novel approach that has the potential to provide significant insights into the role of plant foods in human health and disease.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how plants can promote human health.
understanding the mechanisms by which plant foods reduce the risk and severity of chronic diseases.
understanding the molecular mechanisms that underlie the beneficial health effects of plant foods and the application of this knowledge to the development of foods that are better for human health.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
plant science has the potential to contribute to the understanding of which foods promote health and how these foods reduce the risk for chronic disease.
research on plants can make significant contributions in the areas of nutrition and human health.

plant biochemistry, genetics and metabolic engineering have the potential to make significant contributions to the promotion of human health through the production of novel foods with enhanced nutritional value and through the elucidation of the role of plant-derived metabolites in human health.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
plant science is an essential part of the solution to reducing the impact of chronic diseases.
plant science has the potential to make significant contributions to the promotion of human health.
plant scientists can contribute significantly to the reduction in chronic disease through the identification of phytonutrients and the elucidation of their mode of action in human health.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the complexity of the plant food-health relationship can be addressed by the application of the tools of modern plant science.
plants have a great capacity for producing a diverse range of metabolites, many of which have been shown to promote health.
plants are a rich source of bioactive compounds that can promote human health and that research on plants can make important contributions to understanding how the diet impacts human health.
